page.notes: Catchword "ut" set at the lower right is given in bottom_margin, not in the text. Line-end hyphens kept as printed: "juris-" (printed "jurif-", the long s looks like f), "Di-" with "oecesi", "Re-ligiosi", "pora-tis" (printed "pora-", read as "para-" with [?] not applied since the word is clear from context; the first letters are blurred). Spelling changed for u/v and i/j only: "qvæ" to "quæ", "qvam" to "quam", "æqvam" to "æquam", "qvorum" to "quorum", "gratiamqve" to "gratiamque", "reqviri" to "requiri".
